S01.name: dual-path starts from identical state and conservative selector is deterministic
S01.details: Both path A and path B branch from state.clone(); _select_conservative_state applies deterministic four-level hierarchy (marked equity, inventory, fees, path name tie-break).

S02.name: no hidden 15m execution fallback
S02.details: Fills and crossings use 1m candles exclusively. Missing or discontinuous 1m candles flag PENDING_DATA_GAP without falling back to 15m candles.

S03.name: slot duplicate prevention + re-arm
S03.details: Opening checks slot_index not in open_lots; closing pops slot from open_lots, re-arming it.

S04.name: terminal close/costs cannot double count
S04.details: Terminal close liquidates remaining open lots only; sets is_terminal=True to prevent further crossings; sums paired cycles and terminal liquidation without overlap.

S05.name: funding ambiguity cannot create authoritative net-after-funding
S05.details: Ambiguous boundary funding sets status to AMBIGUOUS_FUNDING_BOUNDARY and forces funding_pnl and net_pnl_after_funding to None, validated fail-closed.

S06.name: utilization cap is structural
S06.details: Unit notional is 1.0/N, maximum lots is N, bounding peak capital utilization to 1.0 reference capital.

S07.name: future diagnostics cannot feed fill simulation
S07.details: Fill simulation executes completely before _compute_future_policy_diagnostics is called; future assessments cannot mutate frozen plan or past fills.

S08.name: pending->resolved allowed; resolved immutable
S08.details: In src/btc_quant_agent/market_watch/state.py:1773-1789, save_grid_shadow_evaluation unconditionally raises TacticalGridShadowEvaluationConflictError on any pre-existing natural key with a different evaluation_id, with no exception for pending rows. GridShadowEvaluationManager persists pending evaluations (PENDING_HORIZON / PENDING_DATA_GAP); when forward candles arrive to resolve the episode, attempting to save the resolved evaluation raises TacticalGridShadowEvaluationConflictError. This violates Frozen Semantics #21 and prevents pending rows from ever resolving.

S09.name: source evidence deeply verified before persistence
S09.details: save_grid_shadow_evaluation verifies B1 evidence existence in DB, deserializes payload, verifies cryptographic SHA256 identity, and enforces schema validation.

S10.name: B2A natural key/funding/path semantics unchanged
S10.details: tactical_shadow_evaluations_v2 table, unique index, and B2A directional evaluation structures remain completely isolated and intact.

findings.description: Pending grid shadow evaluations cannot resolve to RESOLVED in database because save_grid_shadow_evaluation unconditionally rejects updates to existing natural keys, raising TacticalGridShadowEvaluationConflictError.

ADVERSARIAL_COVERAGE_GAP: Test suite A01-A35 tests divergent replay rejection (A04) and memory-only evaluation of incomplete coverage (A06), but omits end-to-end database persistence tests for the pending-to-resolved lifecycle.

blockers: S08_BLOCKER: In src/btc_quant_agent/market_watch/state.py:1773-1789, save_grid_shadow_evaluation unconditionally raises TacticalGridShadowEvaluationConflictError on any pre-existing natural key with a different evaluation_id. When GridShadowEvaluationManager persists an evaluation in PENDING_HORIZON or PENDING_DATA_GAP status, subsequent re-evaluation upon candle arrival attempts to save the newly RESOLVED evaluation and crashes with TacticalGridShadowEvaluationConflictError. This violates Frozen Semantics #21 ('Resolved authoritative evaluations are immutable; only pending rows may later resolve') and fails Phase 5 Semantic Review S08.
